name: zzT3_night_shape

tests.name: each rung agrees with itself -- two reads of the same hour
19:30 reads the same in this run as it did in zzT2, so the two tables concatenate

detail.note: the same camera, patch and settle in a different PIE session. A gap here means either the world does not reproduce between sessions or one of the two runs is not what it claims

tests.name: the night keeps darkening after the night rig is fully on

detail.note: INFORMATIONAL DIRECTION, not a pass/fail of the world: this being green confirms that Nightfall is not what drives the late night, so a fix to Nightfall cannot address it

tests.name: the decline has no step in it -- consistent with occlusion, not with a switch

detail.note: a pitch-driven occlusion grows smoothly. A single step much larger than the others means something turns on or off at that hour and the occlusion story is wrong

tests.name: the ground stays readable across the whole night

detail.note: the same floor zzT2 used, so the evening and the night are judged on one scale
